---
format:
  letter-typst: default
params: {party: null}
---



I think you should know something.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

if(params$party == "D"){
  cat("Message for a democrat senator.")
} else if (params$party == "R"){
  cat("Message for a republican senator.")
} else {
  cat("Message for an independent senator.")
}
```

We can also do this in-line. This is an `r if (params$party == "D") "in-line message for a democrat senator" else if (params$party == "R") "in-line message for a republican senator" else "in-line message for an independent senator"`.

We can also do entire chunks.  

```{r}
#| eval: !expr params$party == "D"
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

cat("Message for a democrat senator.")
```

```{r}
#| eval: !expr params$party == "R"
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

cat("Message for a republican senator.")
```

```{r}
#| eval: !expr params$party == "I"
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

cat("Message for an independent senator.")
```

Thanks
